items.text: Customer approved the sample. Handover to production completed, order created.
items.author: Kavya Reddy (ERGO)

items.text: Our line trial is booked for the 20th. Can the samples reach us by the 17th?
items.author: Sanjay Malhotra (Bharat Motors)

replies.text: Yes, dispatch is planned for the 14th by road.
replies.author: Kavya Reddy (ERGO)

items.text: Please share the heat-treatment batch records with the sample report.
items.author: Rohit Desai (Acme Automotive)

replies.text: Will do; they are attached to the PPAP package.
replies.author: Kavya Reddy (ERGO)

items.text: First-off pieces are ready for CMM. Layout report will be uploaded tomorrow.
items.author: Harish Gupta (Precision Castings)

items.text: Trial run is two days behind; the gauge drawing revision is the blocker.
items.author: Kavya Reddy (ERGO)

replies.text: I have escalated with the customer. Expect the revised drawing by Friday.
replies.author: Asha Admin (ERGO)

items.text: We can reduce the piece price by 1.5% if the annual volume is committed for two years.
items.author: Prakash Shah (Precision Castings)

replies.text: Noted. We will take this to the customer.
replies.author: Ravi Rao (ERGO)

items.text: Can you confirm whether the die casting tool is included in your tooling cost?
items.author: Ravi Rao (ERGO)

replies.text: Yes, the full die set and one spare insert are included in the tooling cost.
replies.author: Sunil Patel (Shakti Forgings)

items.text: We are closing this RFQ as the customer sourced the part locally. Thank you for the opportunity.
items.author: Ravi Rao (ERGO)

items.text: Deccan declined; Shakti and Precision are within 3.5% of each other. Waiting for the third quote before scoring.
items.author: Ravi Rao (ERGO)

items.text: Waiting for your answer on the cam lobe hardness and the allowed runout.
items.author: Ravi Rao (ERGO)

items.text: The tooling cost is higher than our budget. Is there room to amortise part of it in the piece price?
items.author: Alice Iyer (Acme Automotive)

replies.text: We can offer a 12-month amortisation option; sending a revised quote shortly.
replies.author: Ravi Rao (ERGO)

replies.text: Thank you, that works for us.
replies.author: Alice Iyer (Acme Automotive)

items.text: Precision has the best delivery record on forged knuckles; price is 3% under the next supplier.
items.author: Ravi Rao (ERGO)

replies.text: Agreed. Acme asked for the PPAP date; we can commit to week 12.
replies.author: Kavya Menon (ERGO)

items.text: Please confirm the quote covers the zinc-nickel coating and 720 h salt spray requirement.
items.author: Alice Iyer (Acme Automotive)

replies.text: Confirmed. Coating and salt-spray test are included; test reports will be part of the PPAP package.
replies.author: Ravi Rao (ERGO)
